items.title: Henry "Sleepy" Robertson Interview, 1961-09-22
items.q: You take like Happy out there, me, lots of the old mafias, a lot of us old drummers

ctx.x: Every time you go up with your...

You come down with your left foot, you come down with that hand. But if you hit off with your right feet, you throw the whole band. You see, everybody's supposed to come down on their left foot. You start off with your left foot? On your left foot, and you hit them. You hit them off that left foot and come down, every man come down on your left foot, you'll be in time. If you're left foot and your right hand... That's right. You'll come down on your left foot. All that music will stay on the level. That's right.…
Oh yeah, sure, the bass drummer...
